headline: Why Your Sewer Keeps Backing Up in Summerlin: Understanding the Causes
articleBody:
Dealing with a recurring sewer backup in your Summerlin home is incredibly frustrating and often points to a deeper issue than just a simple clog. It's not normal for your sewer to back up repeatedly, and understanding the common culprits can help you address the problem effectively. Don't ignore these persistent warning signs!

What Can Change the Right Choice:
Pinpointing whether the backup originates from your home's private sewer lateral or the public municipal sewer system is a critical first step. This distinction dictates who is responsible for the repair and the process involved. Your plumber should have the expertise to determine this, potentially using camera inspections to assess the condition of your lateral line. The age of your home and the types of trees on your property or along your sewer line can also be major factors, as older pipes are more prone to damage and tree roots are notorious for causing blockages.

When Professional Guidance Helps:
When you're facing repeated sewer backups, especially if they affect multiple drains or bring sewage into your home, it's definitely time to call in the professionals. Trying to clear these on your own often provides only temporary relief, leaving the underlying cause unaddressed. A qualified professional can use specialized equipment to inspect your sewer line, identify issues like tree root intrusion, cracks, collapses, or bellied pipes, and recommend the most effective long-term solution. CG Plumbing Solutions, serving Summerlin, is licensed and insured to handle these complex sewer line inspections and repairs.

How to Compare Your Options:
When choosing a plumber for recurring sewer issues, look for emergency availability, since backups are always urgent. Ensure they have appropriate plumbing equipment for sewer line work, including camera inspection capabilities. Confirm they are licensed and insured, and ask for a written scope of work and pricing before any major repairs. A plumber experienced in distinguishing private-line failures from municipal problems will be invaluable in Summerlin.
